verdict.rationale: Only community reports support this story. One user calls the OCR "super fast", and another contrasts it with a slower async tool, which implies Mistral returns results synchronously. A third hit a timeout on a single 900-page call, which also points to a synchronous request with practical size limits. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a synchronous vs. async mode, documented per-mode latency figures, and independent latency benchmarks.
